caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a jacket or outerwear, shown from two perspectives: the front view at the top and the back view below it. The jacket is primarily dark green with a textured appearance and features a wide, open front. It has three-quarter length sleeves. Both the cuffs and the hem are decorated with a multicolored diamond or checkered pattern in pastel shades of blue, pink, yellow, and white. The front edges and bottom hem are outlined with a yellow zigzag line, and the sleeves also feature a yellow parallel line detail with a small diamond motif. On the back of the jacket, there are additional geometric designs composed of small yellow dots forming triangles, and a similar yellow zigzag line runs along the hem. The inside lining of the jacket, visible at the front opening, is a light tan color. The drawing is on a neutral, cream-colored background, and there is a signature, “S. Swansen,” at the bottom right corner.
title: Lady's Bolero
